title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・渾身のロングラン

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan runs with all her might in the spring Tenno Sho, and with her victory, she puts a stop to Mejiro McQueen's ambition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though frustrated by defeat, McQueen congratulates Ryan on her win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that Ryan is the one ahead, she declares herself ready to take on any challenge from McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next goal is the spring race that decides the medium-distance champion—the Takarazuka Kinen. If she does well, then her ranking in the fan poll is sure to rise!
